thread:
maria: Quick check — Ruby SDK (0.9.7) + service-account impersonation: after token rotation our streaming clients get an immediate 401 on reconnect. Anyone seen this? Repro steps: open stream, rotate SA key via KMS -> new JWT granted, client reconnects and gets 401. Config snippet: ```client = Redwood::Client.new(auth: {impersonate: 'projects/123/serviceAccounts/foo@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com', token_refresh: true})```

james: Seen something similar in Go. Two likely causes: server-side OIDC cache TTL or the client reusing an old cached JWT during reconnect. Did you capture the outgoing Authorization header and the server validation logs?

maria: I checked both — client sends Authorization: Bearer <new-token> but server audit shows it validated aud=projects/old-project. So server looked at an old aud claim somehow.

alisha: Could be key rotation propagation or a stale mapping in our OIDC gateway. Also check token iat/exp and the impersonation resource string — if the impersonation resource references an old project id the minted token will carry that aud.

maria: iat/exp look fine. The impersonation resource is `projects/123/serviceAccounts/...` but we did move the SA between org folders recently, might be a leftover mapping.

ryan: Short-term workaround: let the client send an explicit audience override that matches what the runtime expects: `auth: {audience: 'https://inference.redwood.com/'}`. Ruby helper could expose an `audience` option so reconnects always present the expected aud.

james: Agreed. Also add a small reconnect safety: when socket reconnects, force a full re-auth (block until token refresh completes) and add jittered backoff. Right now our reconnect path may reuse pooled connections and race with the refresh.

maria: I'll try forcing a full token refresh + closing the socket on reconnect and see if that prevents the 401. If it fixes, I'll open an SDK PR with the audience override + a guarded reconnect.

alisha: :thumbsup: If this hits customers, file a short incident note and include the repro. Helps support triage.

ci-bot: deploybot: CI green on branch fix/ruby-impersonation-reconnect. Tests added: unit for token refresh + integration against a mock OIDC provider that returns swapped aud metadata.

maria: Thanks — opening PR now and will @eng-oncall if anything spikes in prod. Repro snippet will be in the PR description.
